iter2_objections.finding: The S17 helper as specified will EXIT NON-ZERO under set -euo pipefail in the SUCCESS case, which is the mode production scripts and dev test scripts use. When the inner grep -nE finds matches but ALL of them are filtered by the subsequent grep -vE allowlist (the normal case for clean scripts), the second grep -v exits 1 (no output), pipefail propagates the failure, and any caller using count=$(audit_no_executable ...) under set -e will abort BEFORE the assertion runs. Empirically reproduced.
evidence: Test script under set -euo pipefail: count=$(audit_no_executable '\bgit fetch\b' scripts/rollback.sh) — bash exits with code 1 instead of capturing count=0
Reason: grep -v PATTERN with no surviving lines exits 1 (same as no-match); pipefail propagates this; the wc -l output of '0' is captured but the script aborts before count assertion runs
BA spec lines 406-413 specify the exact helper body that has this defect
S17.2 (line 390) and S17.3 (line 391) BDD use the form count=$(grep -nE ... | grep -vE ... | wc -l) which inlines the same broken pattern
